block_yield_options_if_reused_on_new_ses.context: As of 2026-09-28, ZERO new (i.e. not SHG_1/_2, not the 3 V25 Type2 sessions) acquisitions are confirmed as usable EVAL block sources: the only header-config match to the reference (20260112_Type2PPLN_3s) has only 4,782 (N)-window=200 pairs total (INSUFFICIENT, 0 blocks); the other 7 acquisitions (4x Type0_nofilter, 3x Type2 V25) all show a header-config MISMATCH (resolution=Standard vs HighResB, normalization=True vs False, resolution_rms=2.0 vs 1.5 -- see configs.json). No session with matching config + unused + adequate pair count currently exists in the 10-acquisition inventory. The formulas below are therefore illustrative only (evaluated on the two REFERENCE sessions' own already-consumed frame budgets), not a concrete plan -- PI must decide whether to (i) relax the config-match requirement given the earlier PI ruling that Type0/SHG source differences have no IR effect (a different question from these ELECTRONICS/resolution-mode settings differing), (ii) seek new acquisitions, or (iii) accept 0 new EVAL sources from this inventory.

scheme_A_reference_segmentation_as_is.description: CAL(1024f, M0 incumbent) + CAL32(32f, M2 candidate) + CHAR(782f) + HELDOUT(560f) + EVAL(1792f=14x128) + RESERVE(remainder); mirrors g2_freeze_config.json/g3_freeze_config.json disjointness_matrix exactly.
scheme_A_reference_segmentation_as_is.extra_eval_blocks_beyond_existing_14_for: floor((n_frames_post_skip - 4190) / 128) [only if n_frames_post_skip > 4190; CAL/CHAR/HELDOUT are fully consumed by the fixed 4190-frame prefix and never re-split down]
scheme_A_reference_segmentation_as_is.note: Renamed 2026-09-28 from 'eval_blocks_per_session_formula' (nbpolar-data-use-rules-revision T1(v), design.md D9): this formula counts ONLY additional EVAL blocks available beyond the frame range 4190+ (i.e. beyond the existing frozen 14-block EVAL segment at frames 2398-4189, which is separately accounted for in DATA_LEDGER.md). It does NOT count the 14-block EVAL segment itself. The underlying numbers were never wrong -- this is a naming-clarity fix only, per docs/decision-log.md 2026-09-28 'data-use rules R1-R5 adopted' entry.
scheme_A_reference_segmentation_as_is.sessions_needed_for_65_blocks: undetermined -- 0 currently known qualifying new sessions; would need sessions with (n_frames_post_skip - 4190) >= 128*k pairs, i.e. each additional full-tier session (~4200+ frames, matching the reference scale) yields ~0-1 extra blocks under this scheme; this segmentation is EVAL-block-poor by design (94% of frames go to CAL/CHAR/HELDOUT) and is NOT a realistic route to 65 new blocks without many new full-length sessions

scheme_B_high_eval_fraction_alternative.description: PI-suggested contrast scheme: CAL kept at 32 frames only (drop the 1024f A1 incumbent CAL and the 782f CHAR and 560f HELDOUT segments entirely), remainder split EVAL + a small RESERVE (e.g. RESERVE = one block's worth, 128f, held back per session as a spare/contingency; PI to set the actual RESERVE size).
scheme_B_high_eval_fraction_alternative.sessions_needed_for_65_blocks: at RESERVE=0: ceil(65/32.5)=~2 full-length (SHG-scale, ~4200-4300 post-skip frames) sessions; at RESERVE=128: ceil(65/31.5)=~3 sessions -- BUT this scheme has never been used on real data in this project (no frozen freeze config implements it) and would require a new OpenSpec change / freeze review before any real block could be drawn under it (AGENTS.md SS3/SS10.3); it also foregoes the large-CAL M0 incumbent arm entirely, which is a scientific-scope decision for the PI, not this inventory pass

block_yield_options_if_reused_on_new_ses.caveat: Neither scheme currently has an eligible NEW session to apply to (see context above); the per-session yield numbers are evaluated on SHG_1/SHG_2 purely to show what the two formulas WOULD give, since those are the only two sessions with an actually-measured n_frames_post_skip in this pass.
